journey.title: Consent to a medium-risk host safeguard
journey.purpose: An operator opts into a safeguard that modifies host state, having seen its risk, privilege, what it writes, and its configurable fields before consenting.

steps.intent: Read the safeguard's risk, privilege, and what it writes.
Expand and edit a declared config field.
Submit an invalid value and see the failing field named.
Correct the value and opt in.
Apply and confirm the safeguard was applied with the declared privilege.

claims.statement: Risk, privilege, and the host change are all visible before the opt-in is possible.
An invalid config value names its field and leaves the stored document unchanged.
